intro.body: We’re engineers, operators, business leaders, and community builders who care about making everyday systems work better.

story.lead: Veranda is built by people who care about <mark>making everyday systems work better</mark>.
paragraphs: Our team brings together software, hardware, wireless, logistics, food systems, and community impact. Those different perspectives shape how we build, how we partner, and how we think about the future of deliveries.
We believe good technology should feel practical, dependable, and easy to use. Our culture is hands-on and collaborative, grounded in solving real problems for real households.

As we grow, we’re building a company defined by trust, accessibility, strong partnerships, and meaningful impact, alongside people who share our mission to bring reliable, accessible delivery to the communities that need it most.

people.name: Nic Durish
people.bio: Nic is a computer scientist and digital strategist with more than a decade of experience building practical technology across academic, public-sector, and commercial environments. His work has ranged from studying the digital divide in rural communities, to developing accessible software for local governments, to designing scalable cloud infrastructure for large enterprise systems. As CEO, Nic leads Veranda’s product vision, technical strategy, and long-term growth.

people.name: Joshua Wong
people.bio: Josh is a technology executive, RF systems expert, and hardware innovator with deep experience in wireless communications, antenna design, and connected-device engineering. He previously managed the Antenna Design Team at BlackBerry, leading engineering on antenna systems for BlackBerry smartphones and tablets. As CTO, Josh leads Veranda’s hardware architecture, embedded systems strategy, and wireless communications development.

people.name: Dion Dawson
people.bio: Dion is a social entrepreneur, technology executive, and communications strategist who builds organizations at the intersection of logistics, food accessibility, and social impact. He is the Founder and Chief Dreamer of Dion’s Chicago Dream and CEO of Cosmic Crate, with work recognized by the White House, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Innovation Awards. As Chief Communications Officer, Dion shapes Veranda’s public narrative, partnerships, and market presence.

people.name: Patrick Houlding
people.bio: Patrick is a software engineer with a background in mobile applications, cloud-connected systems, and resilient networking. His previous work includes building user-focused mobile apps, improving system reliability through test-driven development, and researching Mobile Ad-Hoc Network technologies. As Director of Software Development, Patrick leads Veranda’s mobile app, cloud services, and partner-facing systems.

board.title: Board & advisors
board.body: Experienced operators from retail, technology, finance, manufacturing, and logistics who help guide how Veranda grows.

people.name: Terry Sweeney
people.bio: Co-founder and former CEO of Veranda. Former retail CIO and a founding leader of Toronto’s Daily Bread Food Bank.

people.name: Paul Oulahen
people.bio: Toronto entrepreneur and real estate broker with more than 40 years of building businesses. Advises on growth and investment.

people.name: Dennis Tobin
people.bio: Corporate lawyer specializing in retail leasing, M&A, and venture deals for major retailers and growth companies.

people.name: Perry Caicco
people.bio: Former retail president and CIBC Managing Director. Ranked Canada’s #1 Retail and Consumer analyst for 15 years.

people.name: John Kim
people.bio: Former investment professional across asset management and private equity funds. Now an investor, advisor, and board member for technology startups.

people.name: Gale Blank
people.bio: Former CIO of Reitmans, Walmart Canada, and Loblaws, and VP & Chief Architect for Walmart globally.

people.name: Dietmar Wennemer
people.bio: CEO of Virtek Vision and former BlackBerry SVP of Product Development, where he led 1,200 engineers.

people.name: Joseph Evangelist
people.bio: Vice Chair of Transervice Logistics, a large New York-based 3PL.

cta.title: Open to discussions and partnerships.
cta.body: Whether you’re exploring a pilot, a strategic partnership, or just want to learn more about what we’re building, we’d love to hear from you.
